## Cantarivo release checklist

- [ ] This change contains no credentials, private contracts, recordings, transcripts, or personal data.
- [ ] Android microphone, background-session, and backup behavior still matches the public Privacy Policy and Data Safety review.
- [ ] New audio, lyrics, stems, voices, models, or metadata have documented rights and attribution.
- [ ] `node --check app.js` and the repository quality checks pass.
- [ ] Public-site changes are intentional; no private repository directory is copied into the Pages artifact.
- [ ] A human owner has reviewed the change before merging to `main`.
